idea: 行业-市值双维度中性：通过笛卡尔积构建行业×市值五分组(按市值分位0-0.2,0.2-0.4等)，在细分同质组内对集中度进行标准化(group_zscore)，消除规模与行业混杂效应；海外敞口采用3日均值并经幂变换(0.8)压缩，仅在双源一致且非缺失条件下激活，实现更精细的特质风险剥离。
expression_list: group_zscore(multiply(group_zscore(rsk74_raw_concentration, group_cartesian_product(industry, bucket(rank(ts_mean(cap,21)), "0,1,0.2"))), trade_when(and(less(abs(subtract(rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile1, rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile2)), 0.05), not(is_nan(rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile1))), signed_power(ts_mean(add(rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile1, rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile2), 3), 0.8), 0)), industry)
